translations.web: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.
translations.bsb: A drought is upon her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
translations.kjv: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
